gloss: the year at its stillest, everything held
the coldest stretch, roots waiting
the first tilt back toward the light
frost loosening into rain
the sleeping world begins to move
day and night in balance, tipping bright
clear skies, the green returning
rains that feed the new growth
warmth settling in, days lengthening
seedheads filling, abundance gathering
the long days building toward their peak
the longest day, fullness at its height
rising warmth, the slow simmer of summer
the hottest stretch, everything ripening
the first cool edge to the air
the heat releasing its grip
cool mornings, dew on the grass
balance again, tipping toward the dark
dew turning cold, leaves letting go
the first frosts, the world drawing in
stillness arriving, the light pulling back
the first snows, the hush before deep cold
snow deepening, the long dark
the longest night, the seed of returning light
